assets.name: pixel-sky-v1
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: background for a vertical mobile side-view ladder bridge game. Primary request: bright BLUE SKY in genuine crisp 16-bit pixel art. Portrait 9:16 composition. Sky fills every edge, upper blue/cyan with a very subtle stepped palette becoming lighter lower down, a few white and pale-blue blocky pixel clouds scattered at different heights, large calm negative spaces for UI and gameplay. Pixel clusters with clean hard stair-step edges, limited blue palette, no smooth paint or blurred gradients. No land, no grass, no ground, no mountains, no buildings, no characters, no sun face, no ladders, no platforms. No border, no text, no UI, no watermark. Background fully opaque. Charming classic side-view platform-game look, clouds must not look like 3D blocks.

assets.name: pixel-dirt-v1
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamlessly tileable square dirt material for 2D pixel-art platform sides. Primary request: rich warm brown underground soil texture, pixel art, full frame edge to edge. A tight limited palette of medium chocolate brown, deep brown small crevices, ochre square pebbles and sparse earthy tan pixels. Coarse intentional square pixel clusters matching a classic crisp 16-bit platformer. Even density, flat frontal orthographic surface with absolutely no perspective, no shading of a 3D cube. Uniform material that can repeat both vertically and horizontally without a visible border. No grass, sky, roots, flowers, objects, large focal stones, text, frame, logo or watermark. Opaque square texture. NOT a photograph and NOT painterly.

assets.name: pixel-grass-cap-v1
assets.export: 512x33, transparent-margin trim, nearest-neighbor resize, lossless WebP, alpha preserved
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a horizontally repeating grass-edge sprite for a 2D pixel-art platform game. Primary request: ONE long thin vivid green grass/turf band, front orthographic view, about 5:1 width to height. Absolutely straight perfectly flat horizontal TOP surface, spanning left to right; yellow-green highlight on that top edge; varied small dark green blocky tufts hanging DOWN from its lower edge. No tall blades protruding upward above the flat top. Hard-edged square pixel clusters, limited fresh lime/green/forest-green palette, classic 16-bit platformer art. Same turf height at the left and right ends so it can repeat horizontally. Fully visible with transparent clear margins and genuinely transparent background outside the turf. Grass only: NO brown dirt, no floating island, no sky, no flowers, no characters, no floor shadow. No text, UI, labels, border or watermark.

assets.name: pixel-ladder-segment-v1
assets.export: 32x64, transparent-margin trim, nearest-neighbor resize, lossless WebP, alpha preserved
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless repeating ladder segment for a 2D pixel-art extend-and-fall ladder game. Primary request: a front-view wooden ladder tile with TWO straight continuous vertical amber/golden-brown rails and ONE horizontal rung across them at mid-height. Rails exactly parallel and of uniform width. Rail bottoms and tops connect perfectly when identical tiles repeat vertically; NO rail endcaps, rounded ends, feet, taper or gaps. The rung spans all the way between rails. Orthographic flat frontal view, no perspective. Genuine crisp hard-edged 16-bit pixel art with dark brown pixel outlines, ochre plank faces and pale golden pixel highlight along one rail edge. Genuinely transparent background in the spaces between rails and outside the ladder. Centered isolated single ladder tile, square-ish crop with clear outer padding. No entire long ladder, no scene, no icons, no text, no logo or watermark. Make the geometry clean and regular so this can tile seamlessly as one continuous ladder.
